Tutorials, how-to guides and shared resources for the [People in Nature & Climate (PiNC) Lab](https://www.pinclab.co.za) at the African Climate & Development Initiative, University of Cape Town.

Anyone in the lab can add to this site or fix something on it. See [Contributing](contributing.qmd) for how.
